name: UniFi Voucher Site
description: UniFi Voucher Site is a web-based platform for generating and managing UniFi network guest vouchers.
requires: Can be configured via an `options.json` file or via environmental variables.

paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Config file. Remove to use environmental variables instead.

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - IP Address
variables.description: IP address of the UniFi OS Console

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - Port
variables.description: Port of the UniFi OS Console

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - Token
variables.description: The API Key created on the integrations tab within UniFi OS

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - Site ID
variables.description: Site ID for the UniFi OS Console

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - Site Manager
variables.description: Use remote site manager

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - Site Manager Console ID
variables.description: Use remote site manager console ID

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - SSID
variables.description: The UniFi SSID where guests need to connect to (Used within templating and 'Scan to Connect')

variables.name: UniFi OS Console - SSID Password
variables.description: The UniFi SSID WPA/WPA2/WPA3 Password (Can be ignored for 'Open' networks) (Used within templating and 'Scan to Connect')

variables.name: Authentication - Web UI - Enable
variables.description: Enable internal authentication for the voucher portal web UI

variables.name: Authentication - Web UI - Password
variables.description: Password for internal authentication for the voucher portal web UI

variables.name: Authentication - OIDC - Enable
variables.description: Enable OpenID Connect authentication for the voucher portal web UI

variables.name: Authentication - OIDC - Issuer Base URL
variables.description: OIDC issuer base url provided by oauth provider. Example: https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration

variables.name: Authentication - OIDC - App Base URL
variables.description: OIDC UniFi Voucher base url (This application). Example: https://voucher.example.com

variables.name: Authentication - OIDC - Client ID
variables.description: OIDC client id provided by oauth provider

variables.name: Authentication - OIDC - Client Secret
variables.description: OIDC client secret provided by oauth provider

variables.name: Authentication - API - Bearer Token
variables.description: The bearer token used for the API

variables.name: Authentication - Limit Admins to Own Organization
variables.description: Limit voucher administrators to managing only vouchers associated with their own organization. If enabled, system automatically assigns the administrator’s email domain as a note to each created voucher.

variables.name: Voucher Types
variables.description: A semi-colon-separated list of voucher types in the following format: expiration in minutes (required),single-use or multi-use vouchers value - '0' is for multi-use (unlimited) - '1' is for single-use - 'N' is for multi-use (Nx) (optional),upload speed limit in kbps (optional),download speed limit in kbps (optional),data transfer limit in MB (optional)

variables.name: Allow Custom Voucher Types
variables.description: Allow users to create custom vouchers types within the UI

variables.name: Printers
variables.description: A comma-separated list of printer formats and IPs. Example: 'pdf,192.168.1.10'

variables.name: Email - From Address
variables.description: The email address that will be used as the sender of the emails

variables.name: Email - SMTP Host
variables.description: The SMTP host to use for sending emails

variables.name: Email - SMTP Port
variables.description: The SMTP port to use for sending emails

variables.name: Email - Use TLS
variables.description: Use TLS for the SMTP connection

variables.name: Email - SMTP Username
variables.description: The SMTP username to use for sending emails

variables.name: Email - SMTP Password
variables.description: The SMTP password to use for sending emails

variables.name: Kiosk - Enable
variables.description: Enable/disable the kiosk page on /kiosk

variables.name: Kiosk - Voucher Types
variables.description: A semi-colon-separated list of voucher types in the following format: expiration in minutes (required),single-use or multi-use vouchers value - '0' is for multi-use (unlimited) - '1' is for single-use - 'N' is for multi-use (Nx) (optional),upload speed limit in kbps (optional),download speed limit in kbps (optional),data transfer limit in MB (optional)

variables.name: Kiosk - Guest Name Required
variables.description: Require the guest to enter their name on the kiosk page

variables.name: Kiosk - Timeout
variables.description: Sets the Kiosk timeout in seconds (Returns the user back to the starting page after inactivity)

variables.name: Kiosk - Homepage
variables.description: Enable/disable an override to redirect to the Kiosk on the / url (Also enables a link from the Kiosk back to the Admin UI)

variables.name: Kiosk - Email
variables.description: Enable/disable the email voucher button (Requires SMTP to be setup)

variables.name: Kiosk - Printer IP
variables.description: Enable a printer for Kiosk Vouchers (this automatically prints vouchers), e.g. an ESC/POS-compatible printer

variables.name: Tasks - Cleanup Expired Vouchers
variables.description: Enable/disable automatic cleanup of expired vouchers

variables.name: Tasks - Cleanup Unused Vouchers
variables.description: Enable/disable automatic cleanup of unused (> 1 day) vouchers

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level for the application

variables.name: Authentication - Disable
variables.description: Disable all authentication methods

variables.name: Enable Web UI
variables.description: Enable the web UI

variables.name: Enable API
variables.description: Enable the API

variables.name: Translation - Default Language
variables.description: Sets the default translation for dropdowns

variables.name: Translation - Hidden Languages
variables.description: A comma-separated list of language codes to hide from the language selection dropdown

variables.name: Translation - Debug
variables.description: Enables/disables translation debugging, when enabled only translation keys are shown

author: nwithan8
